Five merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `CriteriaBuilder` under `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate`. I checked the 22 default-branch commits that touch that directory since that date, and read each one's diff for added or removed `CriteriaBuilder` lines.

| Merged | PR | Commit | Change to `CriteriaBuilder` lines |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-18 | #6088 (TRUNK-6635, location search by `LocationSearchCriteria`) | `11607283d6100942c99bcdbb6713352f62c0b53a` | Adds `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateLocationDAO.java` |
| 2026-06-01 | #6079 (TRUNK-6633, concept search by `ConceptSearchCriteria`) | `b3a2fa0b2d45c31065f89651f4f9801aa45354b4` | Adds `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAO.java` |
| 2026-07-21 | #6359 (TRUNK-6681, `LocationSearchCriteria` pagination) | `9e011e2c09db99fd5cae20821e203fe9cc5f036b` | Adds `CriteriaBuilder` parameters to new helpers in `HibernateLocationDAO.java` |
| 2026-08-20 | #6410 (TRUNK-6731, obs paging) | `2ce847744295132bbe5fb97f369fab714f09b309` | Adds a Javadoc line with `CriteriaBuilder` in `HibernateObsDAO.java` |
| 2026-10-01 | #6598 (TRUNK-6707, global property caching) | `07e8ea06f244de96907581535d4eff8dadbd0004` | Removes and re-adds `CriteriaBuilder cb = session.getCriteriaBuilder();` in `HibernateAdministrationDAO.java` |

The other 17 commits in that window touch the directory but have no `CriteriaBuilder` lines in their diffs. The one commit without a PR number (`84963803`, a `@since` fix) was excluded because it is not a merged PR.

Caveats:
- **Pinned head:** I could not read the default branch name (`list_repos` returned `defaultBranch: null` and `list_branches` failed). I treated the default branch as the main line. Its newest commit is `0e0255b872f08dabafe9414d623820272cd475be` (2026-10-13), which touches the directory but has no `CriteriaBuilder` change.
